duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh extracts only entry['track'] from Source Playlist items. The current /playlists/{id}/items response uses entry['item'] (the old track field is deprecated), and collector.read_source already accepts both shapes. With 20 valid source entries under item and 20 qualified B tracks, I reproduced a successful Refresh that PUTs an empty uris array and stores an empty Duet. Rule: Refresh must consume the valid Source Playlist item shape before issuing a full replacement; a populated source must not silently become an empty pool.. Scope: Source-item extraction in duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh and end-to-end Refresh fakes/tests in tests/test_playlist.py; keep compatibility with track where required.. Verify: Run app.main(['refresh']) with a fake /items page containing only item objects and qualified B history; assert the PUT and duet_state include the sampled tracks in alternating positions, never an empty uris array..

duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh uses the owner's bearer for GET /playlists/{source_id}/items. The owner may be role B while role A owns a private Source Playlist; Spotify returns 403 unless the caller owns or collaborates on it. I reproduced owner=B/source=A: Refresh exits 1 before any PUT even though A has a live token. Rule: Read role A's private Source Playlist using role A's authorized account; use the owner grant for Duet creation and writes.. Scope: Account/token choice and refresh hook for every Source Playlist read in duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh, plus integration tests for both owner-role assignments.. Verify: Seed distinct A and B accounts with B as owner; make the fake accept Source Playlist GET only with A's bearer and Duet POST/PUT only with B's bearer. Assert Refresh succeeds and stores the ordered Duet..

duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh calls selector.select without the vetoes and cooldowns stored in SQLite. I seeded veto a1 and active side-A cooldown a2, returned both from the Source Playlist, and observed the PUT include spotify:track:a1 and spotify:track:a2. This violates I5 and re-admits tracks explicitly barred by a person or the rotation policy. Rule: Every Refresh must pass all active Veto and side-specific Cooldown exclusions to selection, including cold start and subsequent runs.. Scope: duetflow/db.py read helpers for vetoes/cooldowns, duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh selector inputs, and CLI-level Refresh tests for both sides and expiry boundaries.. Verify: Seed vetoes and active/expired cooldowns in a temp database, run app.main(['refresh']) with a fake transport, and assert no vetoed or actively cooled track appears in PUT uris or duet_state; expired cooldowns may become eligible..

duetflow/db.py:replace_duet_state DELETEs and inserts without a rollback boundary; duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh then calls finish_run in its exception handler, which commits partial inserts. With an existing old row and a SQLite trigger rejecting the second replacement row, I observed persisted duet_state=['new1'] after the failed Refresh, rather than the prior complete state. record_snapshot is also a separate commit from state replacement. Rule: The local record of a successful remote replacement must commit as one complete state plus its snapshot, or retain its previous complete state on local persistence failure; error logging must not commit a partial transaction.. Scope: duetflow/db.py:replace_duet_state and record_snapshot, duetflow/playlist.py:write_duet, and duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh failure handling.. Verify: With an old state, inject an insert failure on the second new slot and separately a snapshot-record failure after a successful fake PUT; after cmd_refresh returns error, assert duet_state is never partial and no new state is committed without its snapshot..

duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh passes the default turnover.per_side=3 into selector.select even when duet_state is empty. With 20 eligible Source Playlist tracks and 20 qualified B tracks, I observed a first Refresh PUT only 6 URIs (3/3), although the task's 20/20 criterion says a Refresh with enough history must fill the target. tests/test_playlist.py obtains 20/20 by constructing a plan with turnover_per_side=20, bypassing the CLI configuration. Rule: When both pools support the target, the first real Refresh must reach the configured 20/20 Duet; cold-start shortage may produce smaller equal halves.. Scope: Cold-start target and turnover handling at duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh and duetflow/selector.py:select, plus an end-to-end test of default configuration; reconcile any tension with I4/ADR-0002 explicitly.. Verify: With an empty duet_state, default config, 20 eligible tracks in each pool, run app.main(['refresh']) and assert exactly 40 alternating URIs and 20/20 stored slots; also test a smaller B pool produces equal smaller halves..

duetflow/app.py:_inferred_candidates reads only local plays and cmd_refresh never requests role B's short-term top tracks. ADR-0003 requires that seed during cold start. With no local plays but a populated short-term top-tracks response, Refresh currently PUTs an empty uris array, leaving the newly created Duet empty instead of starting with equal smaller halves. Rule: Cold-start selection must use the documented short-term top-track seed when recent-play history cannot support an initial Inferred Half.. Scope: duetflow/spotify.py top-tracks read, duetflow/app.py cold-start candidate construction, and CLI-level cold-start tests; owner and B tokens must retain their respective read/write roles.. Verify: With empty local plays, a nonempty Source Playlist, and a fake GET /me/top/tracks?time_range=short_term for role B, run Refresh and assert the PUT/stored Duet has a nonempty equal split; ensure no seed is needed when recent-play candidates already suffice..
follow_ups: The new cmd_refresh path uses collector.token_refresher, but on InvalidGrant its exception handler records only an error run. The account's reconsent_required flag remains false, so the next Refresh retries a known-expired grant and status reports a stale token. The same omission in pre-existing playlist commands is already recorded as a held phase-03 follow-up. Rule: A rejected refresh grant should be durably marked before returning an authentication error.. Scope: duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh and other callers of collector.token_refresher outside collector.collect; the existing phase-03 follow-up covers playlists/use-source.. Verify: Fake InvalidGrant during Refresh, then inspect accounts.reconsent_required=1 and the status message; repeat for the existing playlist commands when their held follow-up is taken..

duetflow/config.py:set_duet_playlist_id copies the existing set_source_playlist read/safe_dump/write_text pattern. A config.yaml with comments loses them on first Refresh, and interruption during write_text can leave the live config truncated after Spotify has already created the Duet; the next Refresh may then be unable to reuse its id. The same pattern in set_source_playlist is already a held phase-03 follow-up. Rule: An automated edit to a human-maintained config file should preserve its annotations and replace the file atomically.. Scope: duetflow/config.py:set_duet_playlist_id and the existing set_source_playlist helper, under the held configuration follow-up.. Verify: Use a commented temp config and assert comments and other keys survive id persistence; inject a failed temp write and assert the original file remains byte-identical, then retry and assert only one id is reused..

With 20 distinct B tracks played once today (score 1.0), 20 valid A source tracks, and 20 B top tracks, an end-to-end CLI Refresh returned success, made no top-track request, and PUT an empty uris array. The new test covers zero local plays but misses insufficient qualifying plays. Rule: At cold start, decide whether B history can fill the Inferred Half by counting eligible, qualified tracks after entry-threshold and exclusion rules; request the short-term top-track seed whenever that count is short, and never replace a populated source with an empty Duet while a usable seed exists.. Scope: duetflow/app.py cold-start candidate/seed decision and its interaction with selector eligibility; CLI-level Refresh tests in tests/test_app.py for below-threshold, vetoed, cooled, and overlapping local/top-track candidates.. Repeat with 20 raw B candidates of which active vetoes/cooldowns leave fewer than 20 eligible; top tracks must fill the eligible shortage. Check an overlapping top track is not lost merely because it had a below-threshold local score..

duetflow/selector.py's growth branch excludes chosen growth tracks only from their own side's remaining pool. A track assigned to Sampled growth can still be selected by the later B swap, and a track assigned to Inferred growth can still be selected by the later A swap. For current=[a-current,b-current], target_size=6, turnover=3, sampled_pool=[a-only,shared], inferred=[b-current(score 0),b-only-1(3),b-only-2(2),shared(1.5)], select raises 'selector produced a duplicate track_id' before Refresh can PUT. I reproduced the symmetric A-swap collision as well. Rule: Every admission selected during paired growth or either side's swap must be globally disjoint across both sides, so an undersized Duet with overlapping pools can complete Refresh while preserving I2.. Scope: duetflow/selector.py's paired-growth allocation, remaining_inferred and remaining_sampled construction, both swap phases, and tests covering growth plus swaps in the same Refresh with overlap in either direction.. Verify: Exercise both collision directions with an undersized current Duet, turnover greater than paired growth, overlapping eligible Source/B candidates, and an evictable incumbent on the opposite side. Assert select returns without exception, all final IDs and admissions are unique, I1/I4 hold, and CLI Refresh issues its one full PUT..

duetflow/selector.py:_max_split always takes B-only candidates before shared candidates, regardless of score or whether A has an exclusive substitute. With sampled_pool=[shared,a-only], inferred=[shared(score 9),b-only(score 1.3)], target_size=2 and turnover=1, it chooses b-only for B and a-only for A, omitting the much stronger shared B candidate even though shared for B and a-only for A gives the same 1/1 split. I reproduced that output; the previous selector chose the higher-scored B candidate in this case. Rule: After maximizing the feasible disjoint equal split, selection must preserve Inferred Half score priority: do not trade a higher-scoring B candidate for a lower-scoring one when A can use another eligible Source track without reducing the split.. Scope: duetflow/selector.py:_max_split in cold start and paired growth, including shared/B-only allocation and score ordering; tests for equal-size feasible allocations with different B scores.. Verify: For the two-track example, assert the B slot is shared and the A slot is a-only. Add a case where A lacks a substitute and assert the algorithm still chooses the largest disjoint equal split; verify both cold start and growth paths..

review_follow_ups.finding: The new cmd_refresh path uses collector.token_refresher, but on InvalidGrant its exception handler records only an error run. The account's reconsent_required flag remains false, so the next Refresh retries a known-expired grant and status reports a stale token. The same omission in pre-existing playlist commands is already recorded as a held phase-03 follow-up. Rule: A rejected refresh grant should be durably marked before returning an authentication error.. Scope: duetflow/app.py:cmd_refresh and other callers of collector.token_refresher outside collector.collect; the existing phase-03 follow-up covers playlists/use-source.. Verify: Fake InvalidGrant during Refresh, then inspect accounts.reconsent_required=1 and the status message; repeat for the existing playlist commands when their held follow-up is taken..

duetflow/config.py:set_duet_playlist_id copies the existing set_source_playlist read/safe_dump/write_text pattern. A config.yaml with comments loses them on first Refresh, and interruption during write_text can leave the live config truncated after Spotify has already created the Duet; the next Refresh may then be unable to reuse its id. The same pattern in set_source_playlist is already a held phase-03 follow-up. Rule: An automated edit to a human-maintained config file should preserve its annotations and replace the file atomically.. Scope: duetflow/config.py:set_duet_playlist_id and the existing set_source_playlist helper, under the held configuration follow-up.. Verify: Use a commented temp config and assert comments and other keys survive id persistence; inject a failed temp write and assert the original file remains byte-identical, then retry and assert only one id is reused..
